quick: 500 to 1000 mg three to four times daily, between meals and at bedtime
summary: Hydrotalcite is a layered aluminium-magnesium antacid with a rapid, sustained buffering effect and low aluminium absorption.

dosage.d: 500 to 1000 mg three to four times daily, between meals and at bedtime

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Buffers gastric acid; binds bile acids and pepsin.

moderate: Reduces absorption of tetracyclines, fluoroquinolones, iron, levothyroxine, digoxin, bisphosphonates and azole antifungals: separate by 2 to 4 hours

serious: Aluminium or magnesium accumulation in renal failure

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
